ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent case of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and explore the broader issue of fraud in the Medicaid system.
questions: What measures can be taken to prevent Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale pattern of fraud and to hold those responsible accountable. By following the money and tracking the flow of funds, we may be able to identify additional cases of fraud and to shed light on the underlying causes of the problem.
